Insight/evidence: E02, E07-E10, E22: owners can't get average sales by weekday/hour from Square
Hypothesis: Opening with 'your average Tuesday, hour by hour' gets more owners to agree to a 15-minute sit-down than a generic 'free report' opener
Variable: Walk-in opening line (A: average-Tuesday opener vs B: October 'free one-page report' opener), alternating by visit
Primary metric: Owners who agree to a sit-down / owners spoken to
Guardrail: No pitching during a rush; no sales numbers of any real business shown
Assets: A02 walk-in script; A01 QR card
Time/cost: About 2 h over two weeks; $0 (print at school)
Dependencies: T01 ref tags on QR card
Decision rule: With 6+ conversations per opener: keep the one with clearly more yeses; fewer than 6 each: directional only, keep both
Learning from failure: If neither opener gets a yes, the problem is access/timing (owner absent, busy), not words: change time of day or ask the manager for intros
